🎥🎬: Hulk Vs. (2009)

In Hulk Vs. Wolverine, Wolverine is sent to track down Bruce Banner, but the mission quickly turns into a brutal fight when Hulk emerges. Their battle attracts the attention of Weapon X, who sees an opportunity to capture both superhumans and use them for their own plans.

In Hulk Vs. Thor, Loki and the Enchantress bring Hulk to Asgard, hoping to use his uncontrollable rage against Thor. But Hulk proves to be far more dangerous than they expected, forcing Thor into a massive battle that threatens the entire realm.

The two stories showcase Hulk going head-to-head with two of Marvel’s most powerful heroes in a pair of action-packed battles.
